name: Volun Teer
source:
21 years old. She is representative of Japanese volunteer Civil Defence Force. She is the commander of volunteer forces, which acts as free of change reinforcements in defensive battles. Spends all her free time to date with deprived men, though she doesn't allow then any physical contact.

"Well... As a part of our voluntary activity, we obliterate any fleet holds ill intends to Japanese Military. To the dust."
